content.short: Euclid Protocol is a unified liquidity layer that lets DeFi apps share liquidity across chains.
content.description: Euclid Protocol builds a unified liquidity layer for DeFi, so apps on different chains can tap the same liquidity with instant execution and easy composability. Its testnet has passed a million unique wallets. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Euclid.
content.meta: Euclid Protocol is a unified cross-chain liquidity layer for DeFi, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
